requirement: A stranger searches restaurants on the sign-in-free /find (the WO plugin's own Find view in public mode); the Google cost is one capped request and the picks reach the signed-in Find

oracle.invariant: S1: 200; exactly one fetch, to places:searchNearby with maxResultCount 20; no row in wo_opportunity or wo_place. S2: the door answers 404 FEATURE_OFF with no fetch; /find redirects to /login?next=%2Fnew%2F%3Ftab%3Dtracy%3Awebsite-opportunities%26wo-view%3Dfind. S3: 404 for both, no fetch. S4: 400 INVALID_SEARCH for each, no fetch, and none of them counts against the address. S5: the fourth is 429 RATE_LIMITED; the third address gets 429 DAILY_LIMIT; with 0 the answer is 429 CLOSED; Google was called only for the answered searches. S6: 502 DISCOVERY_FAILED with one Google fetch and nothing else fetched; the next search is 429 DAILY_LIMIT. S7: the answer is the signed-in row shape with status new, no photo name and no javascript: link. S8: the parameters are removed from the address, the signed-in search runs once, the matching rows are selected, and no research starts. S9: 200 with one Google call: the public routes resolve hosts. S10: both send the same Google request and show the same places (chains hidden); after the hand-over all three picks are selected, the missing one fetched by id through places/suggest/:placeId and the place search. S11: exactly one Google request. S12: nothing is searched, located, restored or stored on mount; the search sends only {query, radiusM}; no image, no Map button, no row action; 10 picks at most; Continue hands on the 10 ids with the point and radius; no research call. S13: signed-in and shard-pointer visitors get 302 to the signed-in Find with wo-at, wo-radius, wo-pick and utm_* kept and no-store; a stranger gets the page when both switches are on, else /login?next=; assets have their own MIME type and never redirect; unknown doors answer JSON 404. S14: no @deepseek-ai module, no plugin index.tsx, styles.ts or lib/client.js, one React; only /find/api/capabilities and /find/api/search are requested; the polls stop on CHECKS_UNAVAILABLE and SOCIAL_STATS_UNAVAILABLE. S15: defaults 10/min and 60/h per address, 60/min and 500/day per deployment; the 11th search in a minute is 429; a changed setting applies without a restart. S16: the row reads researched with its published website check and socials; no opportunityId, siteKey, findAction, private profile, build or demo action appears. S17: one Autocomplete call with the typing session, one Place Details call on the pick, the search goes by its coordinates; each fence answers 429 before Google and plain typing plus Search still work. S18: one Google request serves both Finds; the nearby search is a hit costing no deployment budget, with distances from the new point; an expired answer is asked again; words and picks are asked once; the cache row holds a request hash and Google's body only. A researched place costs nothing; a hostile body is ignored; a search-found page without branch evidence never becomes a link; a price not on its dish row stays unverified; Build demo is the only step that asks to sign in. Each wired provider group follows the order set on /ops/wo; the default order behaves exactly as research did before. S19: the steps card lists every source with its reason; Retry collects that source alone, charges only that source and buys no Google listing photo; a Google retry asks Place Details once more. S20: under 30 calls the row says Not enough data yet with the count; with enough calls it shows calls, usable rate and cost, and a misorder is marked bold; nothing reorders the providers. S21: photo dishes are unverified with source.kind photo and no price unless printed; the website dish wins over the photo; each photo read is one vision ledger row; the menu part has its summary first and the profile part no longer carries the dishes. S22: collected values win, gaps may hold sample content flagged sample: true; a collected review keeps its words and author; QA fails only facts that contradict the research. S23: one logo is chosen with its source and how it was recognised; no logo found offers a Retry of the logo alone.
